summary: Restocks slowed Wednesday and still vanish in 1-2 minutes; keep the 9-11:30 AM window sharp and act on alerts instantly, even overnight.

items.title: Another overnight wave on Oct 29, including Brooklyn
items.summary: Around 1:15-1:26 AM ET, Downtown Brooklyn (256GB Night Sky) and Christiana Mall, DE showed pickup stock; each lasted 1-2 minutes. No NJ or Manhattan store listed.

items.title: Wednesday restocks fell to less than half of Tuesday's
items.summary: US drops dipped to about 595 on Oct 28 from 1,369 the day before. Manzana's latest logged drop came at 11:49 AM ET; mornings remain the peak.

items.title: Bigger production order won't speed up 2026 deliveries
items.summary: Apple reportedly raised its Duo plan about 44%, but spread over 12 months; US online orders still ship around January 25, so pickup is the fastest route.
